user.title: Connect your radio
user.description: How is the radio connected to Home Assistant?

menu_options.serial: Serial port (Connect AUX-2 RS-232, USB cable or socket://)

serial.title: Serial CAT connection
serial.description: Pick the Connect AUX-2 port (listed under Serial proxies). Set the radio's CAT baud rate to match, and turn off RTS/CTS handshaking on the radio: the AUX-2 jack carries only TX, RX and ground.

rigctld.title: Hamlib rigctld
rigctld.description: Connect to a running rigctld, for radios this integration doesn't speak natively.

error.cannot_connect: No reply from the radio. Check the port, protocol, baud rate, cable, and that the radio is on.
error.invalid_civ_address: Enter a hex address such as 94.

abort.already_configured: This radio is already set up.

options.yaesu_newcat: Yaesu CAT: FT-991, FT-891, FT-710, FTDX10/101
